description: Glimmer becomes queen as the war intensifies, Double Trouble destabilizes the Rebellion and the truth of Mara and the Heart of Etheria turns ancient First Ones technology into the season's central threat.

s03e01.description: Glimmer's coronation is overshadowed by grief and sends her with Adora and Bow on a quest for the ancient Chamber of Queens.

s03e02.description: The Rebellion races the Horde to recover Mara's ship while Catra recruits the shape-shifting Double Trouble.

s03e03.description: A celebration in Elberon becomes a Horde trap, and a seemingly helpful village girl named Flutterina joins the chaos.

s03e04.description: A captured Horde transport turns the tables on the squad while Adora hunts a dangerous pulse bot and Glimmer accepts Shadow Weaver's advice.

s03e05.description: A spore storm traps Adora in the Crystal Castle with a damaged Light Hope while Horde cadets are stranded elsewhere in the Whispering Woods.

s03e06.description: Catra sends Scorpia after Entrapta's recordings for Hordak's experiments while Double Trouble works to fracture the Rebellion from within.

s03e07.description: Mermista turns a failed mission into a full detective inquiry when she becomes convinced that a Horde spy is operating inside Bright Moon.

s03e08.description: With the rebellion's friendships under strain, Bow, Sea Hawk and Swift Wind seek a night away and predictably create a fresh crisis.

s03e09.description: Razz slips between past and present, revealing crucial pieces of Mara's history as Adora searches for a way to understand the Heart of Etheria.

s03e10.description: The Princess Alliance splits over whether to use or destroy the Heart of Etheria, and Scorpia arrives asking the Rebellion for help.

s03e11.description: Adora, Bow and Swift Wind brave Beast Island searching for their missing friends while Glimmer goes to Light Hope for answers.

s03e12.description: Entrapta reveals the catastrophic truth about the Heart of Etheria while Glimmer urges Scorpia to reconnect with her runestone.

s03e13.description: Catra and Hordak turn on one another as Glimmer reaches the Fright Zone and Adora races to stop Light Hope from activating the Heart.
